Agent Name: Orchestrator  
Step Number: 5  
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator concluded that the number of stops between Cleveland Park and Reagan Washington National Airport on the same metro line was zero without adequately considering the implications of ending up at the wrong station (in this case, the station nearest to Cleveland Elementary School). The Orchestrator incorrectly treated Cleveland Park (on the Red Line) as the endpoint from Cleveland Elementary School instead of finding the correct endpoint metro station associated with Cleveland Elementary School. This led to an incorrect assumption that no direct route exists without changing lines, bypassing the actual calculation required for stations on a common line.
